nodes.title: Owner hands-on test of production (s9242020), n=1 session, 2026-10-04: rated 0/100. Failures: game grading nonsense; teacher often confused/failing; child saying 'end the lesson' ends it immediately; free-form steering ('talk about something else', 'explain it this way') not understood; 'show me a diagram' ignored; robotic voice; poor teacher animation; weak product design. The automated Wave 1 battery passed while these failed: the batteries test plumbing, not the experience.

Treating green plumbing batteries (API/flow checks) as product acceptance: Wave 1 passed every prod test yet the owner rated the live product 0/100. Acceptance now requires experience tests with real child-like sessions (steering, requests, grading truth, ending) and the owner's own test.
